title: Coding
unavailable: Coding is unavailable for this car / protocol. It is experimental, CAN-only, and profile-gated.
subtitle: ⚠ Experimental — writes can disable functions. Your car, your risk.
readFirst: Read the module first — writes always start from a fresh backup.
confirmText: Write the new coding to {{module}}? The old value is backed up and re-verified after writing.

tweak.title: Tweaks
tweak.help: Curated, reversible one-tap changes. Each reads + backs up the live coding, then writes and re-verifies through the same guarded path. Each badge says whether the bit positions were confirmed on this car.
tweak.confirmEnable: Enable “{{title}}” on {{module}}? The current coding is read + backed up, then written and re-verified.
tweak.confirmRevert: Revert “{{title}}” on {{module}}? The current coding is read + backed up, then written and re-verified.
tweak.unlockFirst: Unlock writing above to apply tweaks.

backup.title: Full backup — clone my car
backup.help: One tap reads every declared module's long coding + adaptation values into a dated snapshot. Export it as JSON to keep in a drawer, and restore coding and adaptation values per module through the same gated writes. Experimental.
backup.connectCan: Connect over CAN to create a new backup. Saved backups below stay exportable.
backup.confirmRestore: Restore {{name}} coding to {{hex}}? This is the same gated write — the current value is backed up and re-verified.
backup.otherCar: This backup was taken from {{car}}, not the car selected now — restore is blocked. Select that car to restore it.
backup.otherVin: This backup was taken from VIN …{{backup}}, but the connected car reports VIN …{{car}} — restore is blocked.
backup.busy: Another module read or write is still running — wait for it to finish.

restore.skipNoChannel: The current car profile no longer declares this channel.
restore.skipNoRaw: The backup could not read this channel, so there is nothing to restore.
restore.skipLocked: This channel needs security access and no unlock is available for this module — read-only.
restore.skipEqual: The car already has the backed-up value.
restore.lockedFirst: Locked — unlock adaptations on the Adaptations screen first.
restore.nothing: Nothing to restore for this channel.
restore.confirmOne: Write {{value}} to {{name}} (DID {{did}})? A backup of the current value is taken first.
restore.connectCan: Connect to the car over CAN to compare and restore adaptation values.
restore.lockedHelp: Locked — unlock adaptations on the Adaptations screen to restore channels. Each write backs up the current value and re-reads it to verify.
restore.confirmAll_one: Restore this {{count}} channel on {{name}}? Each one is backed up, written and re-verified in turn; the first failure stops the rest.
restore.confirmAll_other: Restore these {{count}} channels on {{name}}? Each one is backed up, written and re-verified in turn; the first failure stops the rest.
